name: loop
title: Loop
description: Control Loop window layouts from Raycast with searchable actions, quick commands, and custom keybinds.
author: aryananumula

commands.name: loop-actions
commands.title: Window Actions
commands.subtitle: Loop
commands.description: Search and run built-in Loop actions with favorites and recent history.

commands.name: run-loop-keybind
commands.title: Run Keybind
commands.subtitle: Loop
commands.description: Run a named custom Loop keybind configured in the Loop app.

commands.name: left-half
commands.title: Left Half
commands.subtitle: Loop
commands.description: Snap the frontmost window to the left half of the screen.

commands.name: right-half
commands.title: Right Half
commands.subtitle: Loop
commands.description: Snap the frontmost window to the right half of the screen.

commands.name: maximize
commands.title: Maximize
commands.subtitle: Loop
commands.description: Maximize the frontmost window with Loop.

commands.name: center
commands.title: Center
commands.subtitle: Loop
commands.description: Center the frontmost window with Loop.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
